title: Game HUD (Wolf Roleplay, across the bottom)
layout_order: world layer: screen effects, downed overlay, adventure stage + chapter title, markers, combat text | target frame (top centre) | combat error (upper third) | notices (top right, newest on top) | bottom HUD: panel plate with raised lip behind the action bar; top edge: name plate (left, wide only) and tabs right-to-left CHARACTER, JOURNAL, COMBAT, BAG, PETS, GAME, LOOK, HELP, INVENTORY, PANEL, GAME: ON/OFF; left: portrait with XP ring + level, up to 3 stat orbs; centre: 12 action slots (keys 1-9, 0, -, =) then WEAPONS (Main, Off when filled, Ranged); right: 8 bag slots, wallet and 'Bag: n kinds' under them; above the action bar: cast bar, buffs; adventure objective line on the tabs' top at the right margin | first-time guide: three callouts and the 'Game Mode is on' card (Got it, Full help) above the right end. Narrow windows: the action bar takes its own row on top.

controls.label: action slot 1-12: ability icon or initials, key top-left, cost bottom-right (LOW when short), ammo bottom-left, cooldown sweep + seconds

source: mCombatHits.add(x, sb, x + S, st, H_ACTION, i, tip);

controls.when: HUD shown, fewer than 12 abilities / 8 items
